items.Title: Software Engineering (AI Building) Intern (Summer 2027)
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Are you a Software Engineering or Computer Science student interested in building with AI and applying it to real engineering problems?

Tektronix is seeking a 12-week Software Engineering Intern to help explore and develop AI-enabled tools for engineering applications. You’ll work directly with experienced engineers, learn emerging AI technologies, and build prototypes that explore new ways to solve engineering problems, find and use technical knowledge, and improve engineering workflows.

What You’ll Do

  • * Develop and experiment with AI-enabled software prototypes for real engineering applications.

  • * Work with technologies such as Python, AI models, APIs, and modern software development tools.

  • * Explore areas such as AI agents, information retrieval, engineering knowledge systems, and workflow automation.

  • * Test ideas, evaluate results, and learn where AI provides value and where it doesn’t.

  • * Collaborate with engineers to understand problems and turn promising ideas into working prototypes.

  • * Document your work and demonstrate your results to the engineering team.

 

Requirements

  • * Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • * Junior-level standing preferred.

  • * Programming experience through coursework, projects, internships, or personal development.

  • * Strong curiosity, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

  • * Interest in artificial intelligence and enthusiasm for learning new technologies.

  • * Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively with others.

  • * Prior experience with AI technologies is helpful, but not required.

Ralliant Corporation Overview

Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next-generation breakthroughs to life — faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission-critical advancements across industries, enabling real-world impact where it matters most. At Ralliant we’re building the future, together with those driven to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and leave a lasting mark on the world.

About Tektronix

Tektronix, a wholly owned subsidiary of Ralliant Corporation, is a place where people are challenged to explore the boundaries of what’s possible, bringing the digital future one step closer every day. Through precision-engineered measurement solutions, we work with our customers to eliminate the barriers between inspiration and realization of world-changing technologies. We believe that cultivating a deeper sense of loyalty and belonging is key to how we attract and retain our best people. This reality inspires our Inclusion & Diversity vision, We Are More Together, and guides our approach as we all work toward creating great places where our teams work and thrive. Realize your true potential at Tektronix – join us in revolutionizing a better tomorrow!
